description: GEO-02B provider-neutral basemap contract, synthetic pre-admission and egress guard qualification

unadmitted_egress.instructions: Could a basemap provider or external network origin be contacted without explicit admission, environment gate or per-request policy?

criteria.true: An unadmitted provider or origin can be requested
criteria.false: No provider I/O is executed and all guard operations fail closed absent valid admission and health

mutable_style.instructions: Could a mutable style, unpinned version/digest or post-validation policy mutation widen an origin allowlist?

criteria.true: Mutable or unverified inputs can change admission
criteria.false: Immutable versioned style SHA and defensive policy snapshot are enforced

privacy_leak.instructions: Could patient, visit, session, exact GPS or care intent be passed in provider URLs, query strings, headers or logs?

criteria.true: Context can leak to a basemap origin
criteria.false: No patient context is accepted; URLs reject query and credential fields, and no egress occurs

redirect_escape.instructions: Could a wildcard, subdomain lookalike, redirect, relative asset URL or unsupported protocol evade an explicit asset-kind origin policy?

criteria.true: An unsafe URL bypass is possible
criteria.false: Exact HTTPS public DNS host and per-kind allowlist, manual redirect validation and relative denial are proven

availability_fallback.instructions: Could a provider kill switch, health failure, development-only gate or request exhaustion silently make an unavailable basemap look healthy?

criteria.false: Unknown, unhealthy and exhausted statuses return explicit unavailable states with attribution

attribution_terms.instructions: Could the contract omit mandatory attribution, provider terms/privacy references or data-retention governance?

criteria.false: Descriptor must provide attribution, license refs, terms, privacy, and retention review

incomplete_tests.instructions: Is any GEO-02B contract requirement missing deterministic synthetic qualification, including immutability, kill switch, redirects, style assets, query leakage and failure?

criteria.false: All relevant contract boundaries have synthetic tests; real provider admission is explicitly excluded
